# Wedding cakes in Dubai

This is the page text of a guide to wedding cakes in Dubai, saved from a web tool. It explains how to pick a bakery, what a tasting session includes, and how delivery to the venue works. Couples in Dubai often order their cake three to six months before the wedding, and many book a **tasting** first.

## Flavours couples love

Pistachio, saffron and salted caramel are popular. See [our flavour list](https://pagetext.example/flavours).

## How much does a wedding cake cost?

It depends on servings, tiers and decoration. Always ask for a written quote.
